en.app.title: autorate portal
en.label.no_certificates: no certificates in this project yet
en.text.disclosure: selected on the evaluation half; nothing on it was certified
en.text.provenance_mismatch: provenance mismatch: stored digest {stored}, replay digest {replay} - the number below is struck through
en.text.audit_is_markdown: the audit lane publishes a Markdown document (docs/AUDIT.md); it publishes no machine-readable bound
en.text.known_limits_cannot_be_omitted: known_limits is rendered as its own section and cannot be omitted
en.text.feasibility_unstated: the artefact does not state feasibility
en.text.reason_not_published: reason not published by this artefact
en.text.companion_no_verdict: the published groups state neither a refusal nor a bound
en.msg.no_packet: no packet in this project; ingest one with: autorate-portal packet build --source <checkout> --out packet.tar --revision <rev>
en.msg.field_not_measured: the packet never measured the field '{field}'; same-named fields are not the same quantity
en.msg.field_not_a_share: the certificate publishes '{field}', but a share is compared only against the certified autorate; '{field}' is a different quantity, so no comparison is made
en.msg.field_not_a_share_need: no additional data would turn '{field}' into a share; the claim must name autorate
en.msg.unit_mismatch: the claim is in '{claim_unit}' and the certificate publishes its autorate in '{certified_unit}'; units that differ are not compared
en.msg.unit_unstated: the certificate publishes no bound unit; a claim in '{claim_unit}' is not compared to a unit the certificate did not state
en.msg.no_certified_autorate: no certificate in this packet publishes a certified autorate; the claim cannot be bounded against a number that was never published
en.msg.no_required_sample: the artefact publishes no required sample size (no n_min or required_n key); no sample size is invented here
en.msg.missing_pool: the published feasibility arithmetic names the missing input: {statement}
en.msg.size_ladder: published size ladder: n={n}, k_max={k_max}, largest_certifiable_error_rate={rate}, required_observed_accuracy={accuracy}
en.msg.boundary_required: two protocol_digest values in this project ({a}, {b}); the trend is not drawn without a boundary
en.msg.boundary_drawn: boundary drawn between protocol_digest {a} and {b}; no delta is computed
en.msg.supports: claim share {claim_share} {claim_unit} does not exceed certified autorate {certified_autorate} {certified_unit}
en.msg.export_blocked: export blocked: source artefact no longer re-derives ({path}); run id: {run_id}
en.msg.export_blocked_replay: export blocked: a replay run recorded that the source no longer re-derives; run id: {run_id}
en.msg.no_run_row: no replay row records a mismatch at export time; the stored digest is the evidence
en.msg.audit_lane_quoted: the audit lane is quoted, not parsed into a bound

zh-Hans.app.title: autorate portal
zh-Hans.label.known_limits: 已知局限（由 protocol.json 发布）
zh-Hans.text.disclosure: 在评估半集上选出；其上没有任何内容获得认证
zh-Hans.text.provenance_mismatch: 溯源不匹配：存储摘要 {stored}，重放摘要 {replay} —— 下方数值已划去
zh-Hans.text.audit_is_markdown: 审计泳道发布的是 Markdown 文档（docs/AUDIT.md），未发布机器可读的风险上界
zh-Hans.text.known_limits_cannot_be_omitted: known_limits 作为独立章节渲染，不可省略
zh-Hans.text.refusal_without_reason: 记录了拒绝，但未给出理由
zh-Hans.text.correction_published_base: 已修正 {stated}（由产物发布；未修正 {base}）
zh-Hans.text.companion_title: 分组条件伴随面板 / 已发布分组
zh-Hans.text.companion_no_verdict: 已发布分组既未给出拒绝，也未给出上界
zh-Hans.msg.no_packet: 该项目中没有证据包；请先摄取：autorate-portal packet build --source <checkout> --out packet.tar --revision <rev>
zh-Hans.msg.field_not_measured: 该证据包从未测量字段 '{field}'；同名字段并非同一个量
zh-Hans.msg.field_not_a_share: 证书发布了 '{field}'，但份额只与已认证的 autorate 比较；'{field}' 是另一个量，因此不做比较
zh-Hans.msg.field_not_a_share_need: 没有任何附加数据能把 '{field}' 变成份额；声明必须指明 autorate
zh-Hans.msg.unit_mismatch: 声明使用单位 '{claim_unit}'，而证书的 autorate 以 '{certified_unit}' 发布；单位不同则不做比较
zh-Hans.msg.unit_unstated: 证书未发布单位；'{claim_unit}' 的声明不与一个证书未声明的单位比较
zh-Hans.msg.no_certified_autorate: 该证据包中没有任何证书发布已认证的自动化率；无法用一个从未发布的数值来界定该声明
zh-Hans.msg.no_required_sample: 该产物未发布所需样本量（没有 n_min 或 required_n 键）；此处不编造样本量
zh-Hans.msg.missing_pool: 已发布的可行性算术点名了缺失输入：{statement}
zh-Hans.msg.size_ladder: 已发布样本量阶梯：n={n}，k_max={k_max}，可认证最大错误率={rate}，所需观测准确率={accuracy}
zh-Hans.msg.boundary_required: 该项目中存在两个 protocol_digest（{a}、{b}）；未画出分界，因此不绘制趋势
zh-Hans.msg.boundary_drawn: 已在 protocol_digest {a} 与 {b} 之间画出分界；不计算任何差值
zh-Hans.msg.trend_within_digest: 同一 protocol_digest {digest} 内的序列
zh-Hans.msg.refutes: 声明份额 {claim_share} {claim_unit} 超过已认证自动化率 {certified_autorate} {certified_unit}
zh-Hans.msg.supports: 声明份额 {claim_share} {claim_unit} 未超过已认证自动化率 {certified_autorate} {certified_unit}
zh-Hans.msg.export_blocked: 导出被阻止：源产物不再可复现（{path}）；运行标识：{run_id}
zh-Hans.msg.export_blocked_replay: 导出被阻止：一次重放运行记录了源产物不再可复现；运行标识：{run_id}
zh-Hans.msg.no_run_row: 导出时没有任何重放记录报告不匹配；存储摘要本身即为证据
zh-Hans.msg.stale: 证据包已被 protocol_digest {digest} 取代
zh-Hans.msg.audit_lane_quoted: 审计泳道被逐字引用，而非解析成风险上界
